Он стучится на login.microsoftonline.com: It contacts login.microsoftonline.com and gets a code of a few letters and digits. This is the standard Microsoft method for apps without their own sign-in page. It is called Device Code.

Лаунчер ждёт и спрашивает: «ну что?»: The launcher waits and asks: “done yet?”
Пока ты вводишь пароль у Microsoft, лаун: While you enter your password at Microsoft, the launcher keeps asking it: “has the person signed in yet?”. It never sees or asks for your login and password. The “yes” answer comes with a token. A token is a temporary key instead of a password: it proves that you signed in, but it cannot be used to sign in to your account again.
Ключ меняется на пропуск в Minecraft: The key is exchanged for a Minecraft pass
Токен Microsoft лаунчер по цепочке меняе: The launcher exchanges the Microsoft token step by step for Xbox Live, then XSTS, then Minecraft keys, and finally asks Mojang for your profile: nickname and skin. Every stop in this chain is a Microsoft, Xbox or Mojang server. Nobody else is involved.
Ключи ложатся в зашифрованный файл на тв: The keys go into an encrypted file on your computer
Файл называется secrets.bin. Он зашифров: The file is called secrets.bin. It is encrypted with AES-256-GCM. The encryption key is built from a random key that also stays with you and your computer’s ID. On Windows this random key is additionally protected by the DPAPI system. If you copy the files to another computer or another user, they cannot be opened.
Окно лаунчера ключей не видит: The launcher window never sees the keys
Интерфейс (то, что ты видишь на экране): The interface (what you see on screen) never receives tokens. The launcher core strips them from responses and keeps them to itself. When the interface needs to change a cape or start the game, it asks: “do this for account number 3”. The core inserts the token itself. The code has a test that forbids commands that hand tokens to the window.
К нам уходит только то, что нужно нам: Only what we need is sent to us
Запросы к серверам Millida несут только: Requests to Millida servers carry only the Millida account token. Microsoft, Xbox and Minecraft tokens are never sent to our servers. The only places they go over the network are Microsoft, Xbox and Mojang servers, and the game itself at launch.
Это не системная связка ключей, и мы так: This is not the system keychain, and we do not claim it is. On macOS and Linux the file is protected by access rights and bound to the computer. A program running as the same user on the same computer could, in theory, decrypt it. Binding to the Windows user account specifically is provided only by DPAPI.
Сама игра получает токен Minecraft при з: The game itself receives the Minecraft token at launch, this is unavoidable. A mod is ordinary Java code, and technically it can read this token. That is why you should install mods from the catalog and check them with the scanner.

Многим модам нужны другие моды. Лаунчер: Many mods need other mods. The launcher finds them for your version and installs them alongside. If it cannot find them, it shows a warning with the list.

Загрузчики. Установщики Forge и NeoForge: Loaders. Forge and NeoForge installers are run by Java, so the launcher takes their fingerprint from a pinned table (checked on 25.09.2026), and if the file is not there, from the neighboring .sha1 file on maven. Weak spot: some loader libraries are known only by name on maven, and the fingerprint comes from the same site as the file. If our proxy kicked in, they travel the same route.
Для людей из РФ это значит, что моды и з: For people in Russia this means that mods and loaders sometimes really do go through our server. Mojang and Java never go through it.
Сканер модов — это не антивирус. Он дела: The mod scanner is not an antivirus. It runs three checks: against the catalog (it recognizes a mod by its sha1 fingerprint), against a blocklist from our server (the list is kept for 6 hours; if it fails to load, the report says so) and a search for suspicious code inside the file (launching programs, obfuscated classes, nested jars). Result: “ok”, “unknown”, “suspicious” or “blocked”; a suspicious mod can be quarantined with one click. “Unknown” is neither an accusation nor a guarantee; the scanner does not read files larger than 64 MB.

It is issued to sole proprietor Veselov Nikita Nikolaevich and is valid until 09.09.2027. The signature shows who released the file and breaks if the file is changed. The certificate holder applies it manually.
VirusTotal — сайт, который прогоняет фай: VirusTotal is a website that runs a file through dozens of antivirus engines. The Windows, macOS and Linux installers are rechecked every Monday and manually. The latest numbers are above, they come from the most recent report.

After the installer was signed, the check on 13.09.2026 showed 0 detections on Windows (out of 71), macOS (out of 61) and Linux (out of 64).

Ноль на VirusTotal сегодня не значит нол: Zero on VirusTotal today does not mean zero forever: some antivirus may react tomorrow. If one complains, do not click “run anyway” blindly: check the signature and the report.
На macOS установщик не нотаризован Apple: On macOS the installer is not notarized by Apple: the signature there is ad-hoc, that is, without an Apple Developer certificate, and the system may warn you on first launch. We do not call it “signed and notarized by Apple”.
